title: Activity personas and recent conversations
taskScope: Owner finds recent native chats, declares an activity persona, replays membership and sends an explicit order to its fixed native recipient.

actors.name: Project owner
actors.goal: See activity personas and give an individual chat an order

preconditions: Authenticated owner Runtime with sealed keyring and selected execution/node
Trusted native binary and native SQLite directory configured in Runtime launcher
Existing native thread accepts read/resume without permission or provider overrides

failureContract.visibleError: Membership or native outcome could not be confirmed.
failureContract.safeStop: Preserve durable identity and do not repeat an uncertain external effect.
prohibitedSideEffects: Automatic native turns on membership
Source project, history, permission or provider changes
Inferring native UUID from shared actor
Claiming JPD certification without an evidence matcher

promises.statement: The catalog starts with the most recently updated native chats and retains selection.
The node inspector shows recent messages first and keeps older history reachable.
An owner links a real native chat with role and personality without starting a native turn.
Reload preserves declared personas; unrelated technical sessions do not become personas.
An explicit persona order targets only its linked native thread and preserves native settings.
